articles.title: A New Clock Uses the Centers of Atoms to Keep Time
articles.summary: Scientists built the first nuclear clock that keeps itself on time, using thorium and a laser.

articles.title: Many Kinds of Bacteria Cause an Old Mushroom Disease
articles.summary: Scientists found more than 17 kinds of harmful bacteria behind a mushroom disease that has lasted 100 years.

articles.title: Why Some People Hear Music That Is Not Playing
articles.summary: A study of 80 people who hear music that is not there found the songs often come from old memories.
